scenes.line: A fact walks into your head, and leaves through the back door.
scenes.prompt: one person standing centred, a small grey block floating out of the back of their head, open paper field around them

scenes.line: A story moves in, and unpacks.
scenes.prompt: one person standing centred with an open suitcase beside them, small objects rising out of the suitcase in an arc

scenes.line: Your head files things by what happened, not by what is true.
scenes.prompt: one person in profile, the top of the head open like a drawer with colourful folders standing inside it

scenes.line: A fact is one loose item. A story is an item with a hook on it.
scenes.prompt: two small objects side by side on an empty paper field, the right one carrying a simple hook shape, no people

scenes.line: So when you need someone to remember a number, give the number a person.
scenes.prompt: one person holding a large blank card in front of the torso, the card completely empty
two people standing on a shared baseline facing each other, one gesturing, generous quiet margins
one person walking to the right carrying a small glowing shape, a trail of small marks behind them
one person standing centred and calm on an open paper field, a small object resting in their open hand
scenes.caption: Facts inform. Stories stay.
